newsitem.title: USA: TransTexas moving ahead with new drilling.
newsitem.headline: TransTexas moving ahead with new drilling.

text.p: TransTexas Gas Corp said Tuesday it expects to start an expanded development program in its Bob West North natural gas field before the end of June.

The program, which is the result of a cooperative effort from multiple U.S. and Mexican regulators is designed to add 150 million cubic feet per day of daily gross natural gas production from 10 new wells by January 31, the end of the company's fiscal year.
The entire 24 well accelerated development program is expected to be accomplished with capital expenditures of about $50 million, TransTexas said.
TransTexas noted it has enjoyed a 100 percent drilling success rate in Bob West North over the last year as production has grown consistently to become its largest natural gas producing area.

The three new surface locations are intended to allow a three rig development program of a new fault block located under a man-made lake in the Rio Grande River, company spokesman Simon Ward explained.
He said the company's "hope is to double its production and double its reserves" with the 24 well program.
Each location allows for the drilling of eight productive wells, the company explained.
TransTexas said it has been working with multiple government agencies over the last year to ensure that specific environmental and ecological measures it proposed exceeded requirements.

The company also said it is in the process of interpreting its recent Bob West North 3-D seismic shoot to evaluate and develop the deeper "L" series and Roletta sands that it has encountered in previous wells.

Additionally, TransTexas said it had successfully drilled the first 3-D seismic-based well in its Cuba Libre field in Webb County, Texas. The R.V. Benevides C 1 logged 66 feet of pay in two separate Hinnant sands of the Upper Wilcox formation.

The company said it believes these sands were extensions of the nearby Tom Shearman field and that control of the 3-D data provided from this well proves up other locations based upon the 3-D seismic shoot.
